purpose: Exact-image OCR, geometry, section-mark, leader, and native-pixel endpoint evidence for independent review. This is audit evidence, not inventor source material.

geometry.summary: Two semantic reviews and a byte-exact deterministic renderer certificate resolved a raw-geometry dissent. Cross-provider review: The drawing largely matches the specification, depicting a machine with a slab, band, and three blocks on a tile. However, the lines connecting the three blocks on the slab are not specified and are therefore unexpected geometry.

section_marks.summary: The source-view brief requires no cutting-plane designation.

endpoints.summary: The byte-exact component certificate resolves the endpoint provider concern for numeral 20. The final endpoint is certified on its designated rendered component.

labels.evidence: Terminal dot at raw (185, 365) sits exactly on the left-hand outer vertical boundary of the machine silhouette where the slab's left edge meets the band line; the crop shows the ring centered on that outer edge line, clear of the block fronts and of the slab's interior face.
Terminal dot at raw (435, 365) lies in the open front face of the slab, between the heavy top edge near y=340 and the heavy horizontal band line near y=405, well clear of both.
Terminal dot at raw (280, 312) is centered inside the left-hand block's front face, whose outline runs roughly x=238-330 and y=283-350; no edge or corner is touched.
The byte-exact component certificate verifies numeral 20 at raw pixel (585, 312); the certified point is clear inside the exact component designated by the renderer.
Terminal dot at raw (435, 435) lies inside the narrow front strip of the perimeter band, between the heavy band line near y=405 and the lower slab boundary near y=462, clear of both edges.

Terminal dot at raw (900, 600) lies well inside the open quadrilateral tile bounded by the upper edge descending from about (690,455) to (1320,500) and the lower edges meeting at (780,815); no boundary is near the ring.
Terminal dot at raw (435, 305) is centered within the middle block's front face outlined approximately x=397-497, y=283-350, away from every edge.

geometry.summary: The drawing perfectly matches the schematic description provided in the specification. It depicts a rectangular ring (perimeter member) and an inner face (second side) as described, with no extraneous or missing geometry.

section_marks.summary: Located two cutting-plane lines as described in the specification. A horizontal line for section 2, viewing downwards, and a vertical line for section 4, viewing leftwards. Both lines are placed centrally and extend beyond the object boundaries as required. | The specification requires two cutting-plane lines, one horizontal (2-2) and one vertical (4-4). Both lines were located crossing through the center of the provided geometry, extending into the background area as described. The viewing direction for section 2-2 is downwards, and for section 4-4 is to the left, matching the specification.

marks.evidence: The horizontal line carries a short arrow at each end, both pointing toward the lower part of the drawing area, and the numeral 2 at each end, so it reads as section line 2-2 and leads to the sectional view of FIG. 2.

The vertical line carries a short arrow at each end, both pointing toward the left-hand part of the drawing area, and the numeral 4 at each end, so it reads as section line 4-4 and leads to the sectional view of FIG. 4.

labels.evidence: The terminal dot for numeral 16 is at (825, 369). The inner rectangle (second side) spans approximately x=[350, 1050] and y=[180, 720]. The dot is well within these bounds. The horizontal section line is at y=450 and the vertical section line is at x=700. The dot (825, 369) is clear of both section lines (825 > 700 and 369 < 450). This matches the target 'Identified well inside it, clear of the inner edge and of both section lines.'

The terminal dot for numeral 24 is at (190, 369). The perimeter member is the ring surface between the outer rectangle (approx. x=[100, 1300], y=[90, 810]) and the inner rectangle (approx. x=[350, 1050], y=[180, 720]). The dot (190, 369) is within the outer rectangle and outside the inner rectangle, placing it within the ring surface. Its x-coordinate (190) places it clearly on the left-hand side of the ring. The horizontal section line is at y=450 and the vertical section line is at x=700. The dot (190, 369) is clear of both section lines (190 < 700 and 369 < 450). This matches the target 'Identified well inside it along the left-hand side of the ring, clear of both section lines.'
